Privacy Notice on the Processing of Personal Data for Yacht Owner Customers
1. Data Controller

Under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK), the data controller is LİMİT GLOBAL MARINE Denizcilik Onarım ve Teknik Hizmetler Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi ("LGM"). This notice also applies to the yacht owner’s authorised persons, representatives and, in the event of the yacht owner’s death, heirs. In case of any discrepancy, the Turkish text prevails.

2. Personal Data Processed
Identity: first name, surname, Turkish ID number or passport number.
Contact: telephone, email, address.
Yacht information: yacht name, make and model, mooring location, registration and insurance details.
Customer transactions: request, quotation, approval, work order, delivery and warranty records.
Finance: invoice and payment information.
Visual records: photographs and videos of damage and repairs.
Transaction security: YATONET 360 user records and transaction logs.
Voice recordings: recordings of incoming and outgoing calls made through our corporate lines with you, your authorised person or your representative.
Heir / representative data: identity, contact details, certificate of inheritance.

Location in emergency reports: the location of your device (latitude, longitude, time); if location permission has not been given, the registered location of the yacht; the emergency type you select, your description and photographs, if any.
Marketing: communication preferences and maintenance reminder records; only if you give your consent.
3. Purposes of Processing
Receiving and assessing your repair and technical service request.
Conducting the survey, quotation, repair and acceptance processes.
Invoicing and collection.
Monitoring warranty and statutory liability for defects.
Auditing and measuring service quality (including a satisfaction survey, containing no promotional content, sent after the work is completed).
Managing requests and complaints.
Fulfilling legal obligations.
Ensuring information security.
Recording calls made through corporate lines: keeping a record of transactions, ensuring service quality and evidence.
Continuing the file with the heirs in the event of the yacht owner’s death.
Processing of location in emergency reports: planning and carrying out the emergency response, directing the team to the yacht and recording the incident.
Where you have given your explicit consent: maintenance and seasonal reminders, and promotion of services and campaigns.

AI-assisted analysis tools may be used in assessing files; no personal data is transferred to these tools, and the information submitted is masked in advance. These tools only generate recommendations; no decision becomes final without the approval of authorised LGM personnel.
4. Method of Collection and Legal Grounds

Your personal data is collected electronically or physically through YATONET 360, email, telephone, WhatsApp, SMS and written applications, on-site records made during survey and repair, and, if your request is linked to an insurance file, through the relevant insurance company. Calls made through our corporate lines are recorded, with notice given at the start of the call. If you object to the recording, the recording is stopped, the call continues and a summary of the call is entered in the file and sent to you by WhatsApp or e-mail.

When you press the Emergency button, your location in the emergency report is collected automatically through the location permission of the mobile application or browser. The location is sent every 10 minutes until the emergency response to the yacht begins; transmission ends when the team records its arrival at the yacht or when you stop it. You may stop sharing your location at any time; you may exercise your rights regarding this data as set out in Section 7.
Your personal data is processed on the following legal grounds under Article 5(2) of the KVKK:
(c) it is directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract,
(ç) it is necessary for the data controller to fulfil its legal obligation,
(e) it is necessary for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right,
(f) it is necessary for the legitimate interests of the data controller, provided that it does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject.

Call recordings and heir / representative data are processed on the legal grounds of (c) direct relation to the conclusion or performance of a contract and (e) the establishment, exercise or protection of a right.

Location and report data processed in emergency reports are processed on the legal grounds of (c) it is necessary for the establishment or performance of a contract (the service contract) and (f) it is necessary for the legitimate interests of the data controller (emergency response), provided that it does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject.

Processing for marketing purposes and the sending of commercial electronic messages are based solely on your explicit consent (Article 5(1) of the KVKK) and your approval under Law No. 6563. Not giving your consent does not in any way affect your access to the services.
5. Transfer
Your personal data may be transferred to the following recipients only to the extent required by the service:
Solution Partners actually performing the service,
suppliers, technical experts, salvage service providers, and the marinas, shipyards and haul-out yards where the yacht is located,

if your file was referred by an insurance company or its payment is to be made by an insurance company, the relevant insurance company, the loss adjuster it appoints, and a duly licensed insurance broker or insurance agency, a foreign insurance company, surveyor or broker and, where the yacht is abroad, facilities, firms and public authorities abroad (only on the basis of your explicit consent given through the Information Sharing Permission, Article 9 of the KVKK),
legal and financial advisers, the accounting service issuing invoices on behalf of LGM, e-invoice, SMS, telephone (cloud PBX) and hosting service providers, and banks,
public institutions and organisations authorised by law.

Your approvals for commercial electronic messages are notified to the İYS (Message Management System) as required by law. Your correspondence via WhatsApp and email may be transferred to servers abroad of the companies providing these services within the framework of Article 9 of the KVKK; your data in YATONET 360 is hosted only in Türkiye.

Your location data in emergency reports is shared only with the LİMİT GLOBAL MARINE personnel conducting the emergency response and the assigned team and, where required by law, with public institutions and organisations authorised by law; location data is kept in Türkiye and is not transferred abroad.
6. Retention Period
General rule: Your personal data is retained for as long as required by the purpose of processing and for a maximum of 5 years.
Accounting and commercial records: retained for the periods prescribed by law.
Call recordings: retained for the customer file period set out in the Personal Data Retention and Destruction Policy (5 years from the closure of the file).
Emergency location records: retained for 1 year and then destroyed.
Marketing data: retained until you withdraw your consent and for a maximum of 5 years.
When the period expires: the data is erased, destroyed or anonymised.
7. Your Rights
Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to:
learn whether your personal data is being processed,
request information about it if it has been processed,
learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in accordance with that purpose,
know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom it has been transferred,
request its rectification if it is incomplete or inaccurate,
request its erasure or destruction under Article 7 of the KVKK,
request that rectification, erasure or destruction be notified to the third parties to whom the data has been transferred,
object to any outcome against you arising from analysis exclusively by automated systems,
claim compensation if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing,
withdraw your marketing consent at any time.
8. Applications

You may submit your applications in accordance with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Applications to the Data Controller in writing to the address Barbaros Mah. Begonya Sk. Nidakule Ataşehir Batı No:1 İç Kapı No:2 Ataşehir/İstanbul, to our KEP address, or from your email address registered in our system to [●].
Your application will be finalised free of charge within 30 days at the latest. If the process requires an additional cost, the fee schedule set by the Personal Data Protection Board may be applied.
